source.authors: Cortes DH, Jacobs NT, DeLucca JF, Elliott DM
source.sample: 4 mm plugs from 14 lumbar spines: AF from L3-L4 (posterior n=6, outer-anterior n=7, inner-anterior n=5; radial axis), NP and CEP from L1-L2 (5), L2-L3 (6), L3-L4 (1); MRI grade <=3

protocol.summary: Confined compression of 4 mm diameter plugs (AF and NP 1.5 mm thick, CEP 0.8 mm) in PBS. AF: free swelling 3 h outside chamber, thickness at 1 kPa preload, 5 ramps of 10% over 2000 s (0.005 %/s), relaxation 2-6 h. NP and CEP: isometric swelling in the confined chamber (osmotic pressurisation), 3 ramps of 5% over 300 s (0.016 %/s), relaxation 4000/6000/8000 s (NP) or 3000/3000/4000 s (CEP). Biphasic-swelling model (Holmes-Mow solid with beta, exponential permeability k0, M; Donnan osmotic pressure from FCD computed from GAG and water) fitted per sample; Table 3 = same data fitted with a biphasic model without swelling.
how_to_simulate: Model a 4 mm plug in confined compression with porous platen, including Donnan osmotic swelling (FCD per Table 2) in PBS
Reproduce the swelling step then the ramp-hold sequence (strain rate and holds as stated)
Report equilibrium stress-strain and relaxation; compare fitted E, Ha, k0 (or predicted reaction forces)

extraction.check_notes: PMC author manuscript Table 2, text layer (mean +- SD). Parameters are per-sample fits of the stated model to measured confined-compression data. Unit conversion: kPa -> MPa (x0.001); k0 1e-4 mm4/(N s) = 1e-16 m4/(N s) -> reported in 1e-15 m4/(N s) (x0.1); original in 'orig'. NP beta and M given without SD (fixed/pooled). n per tissue: AF 18 (PAF 6, OAF 7, IAF 5); NP and CEP 12 each as read from Methods level counts.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
